Minkštas baldas, ant kurio sėdi keli žmonės.
A soft furniture piece on which several people sit.
In the living room there is a brown sofa.

Baldas, kuriame laikome drabužius.
A furniture piece in which we keep clothes.
The coat is in the wardrobe.

Baldas, prie kurio valgome ir dirbame.
A furniture piece at which we eat and work.
On the table are books.

Lovoje ji yra ant mūsų, kad būtų šilta.
In bed it is on us, so that it is warm.
In winter we need a warm blanket.

Minkštas daiktas lovoje po žmogaus galva.
A soft thing in the bed under a person's head.
My pillow is small.

Balta dalis lovoje, ant kurios gulime.
A white part in the bed on which we lie.
A clean sheet is on the bed.

Minkšta didelė lovos dalis, ant kurios miegame.
A soft big part of the bed on which we sleep.
The new mattress is good.

Daiktas, kuris duoda šviesą kambaryje.
A thing that gives light in the room.
On the table stands a lamp.

Iš jos namuose yra šviesa; ja veikia televizorius.
From it there is light in the house; by it the television works.
Today there is no electricity.

Kai matome – iš saulės ar lempos.
When we see — from the sun or a lamp.
In the room there is much light.

Jomis verdame maistą ant viryklės.
With it we cook food on the stove.
We cook on gas.

Kai namuose žiemą yra šilta.
When at home in winter it is warm.
Heating in winter costs much.

Daiktas prie sienos, kuris šildo kambarį.
A thing by the wall that heats the room.
The radiator is under the window.

Vieta namuose, kur dega ugnis.
A place in the house where fire burns.
In the evening we sit by the fireplace.

Geležinis daiktas kambaryje; jame dega malkos ir šildo namus.
An iron thing in the room; in it firewood burns and heats the house.
In the evening we put firewood into the stove.

Padaryti, kad daiktas veiktų.
To make a thing work.
Please turn on the light.

Padaryti, kad daiktas neveiktų.
To make a thing not work.
In the evening we turn off the television.

Kur prausiamės po vandeniu iš viršaus.
Where we wash under water from above.
In the morning I go to the shower.

Jį geriame; jis yra upėje ir jūroje.
We drink it; it is in the river and the sea.
In the glass there is cold water.

Labai šiltas; ne šaltas.
Very warm; not cold.
The tea is still hot.

Ne šiltas, kaip ledas ar sniegas.
Not warm, like ice or snow.
In winter the weather is cold.

Virtuvės daiktas, ant kurio verdame.
A kitchen thing on which we cook.
The soup cooks on the cooker.

Mašina, kurioje drabužiai su muilu ir vandeniu tampa švarūs.
A machine in which clothes become clean with soap and water.
The washing machine is in the bathroom.

Mašina, kurioje šlapi drabužiai tampa sausi.
A machine in which wet clothes become dry.
The dryer stands in the bathroom.

Mašina, kuri plauna indus.
A machine that washes dishes.
Our dishwasher is new.

Vanduo, kuris teka per laukus ir miestus.
Water that flows through fields and cities.
The Nemunas is a long river.

Vanduo vienoje vietoje tarp laukų ir miškų.
Water in one place among fields and forests.
In summer we bathe in the lake.

Labai didelis sūrus vanduo.
Very big salty water.
In summer we go to the sea.

Didelė vieta be namų, kur auga augalai.
A big place without houses, where plants grow.
Beyond the village there is a big field.

Labai aukšta žemės vieta.
A very high place of the earth.
That mountain is high.

Vieta, kur auga daug medžių.
A place where many trees grow.
In summer we go to the forest.

Žemė, aplink kurią yra vanduo.
Land around which there is water.
A small island is in the lake.

Tai, ką matome pro langą ar nuo kalno.
That which we see through the window or from a mountain.
From the mountain we see a beautiful view.

Miesto dalis, kurioje žmonės gyvena; ten daug namų.
A part of the city where people live; there are many houses there.
We live in a new district.

Vieta miesto viduryje.
A place in the middle of the city.
The old town is in the centre.

Sena ir graži miesto dalis su siauromis gatvėmis ir bažnyčiomis.
An old and beautiful part of the city with narrow streets and churches.
Vilnius' old town is big.

Vieta mieste su medžiais ir gėlėmis.
A place in the city with trees and flowers.
In the morning I jog in the park.

Didelė vieta be namų miesto centre.
A big place without houses in the city centre.
Cathedral square is in Vilnius.

Vieta, kur žmonės siuva drabužius ar daro saldainius.
A place where people sew clothes or make sweets.
Mom works in a sweets factory.

Arklys, karvė, vilkas ar lapė.
A horse, a cow, a wolf or a fox.
On the farm there are many animals.

Didelis stiprus gyvūnas ūkyje.
A big strong animal on the farm.
The horse runs through the field.

Ūkio gyvūnas, kuris duoda pieną.
A farm animal that gives milk.
The cow is in the field.

Mažas greitas gyvūnas ilgomis ausimis.
A small fast animal with long ears.
The hare runs into the forest.

Rudas protingas miško gyvūnas.
A brown clever forest animal.
The fox lives in the forest.

Mažas juodas vabzdys prie maisto vasarą.
A small black insect near food in summer.
A fly flies in the kitchen.

Mažas vabzdys, kuris geria kraują vasarą.
A small insect that drinks blood in summer.
Vakare prie ežero yra daug uodų.
In the evening by the lake there are many mosquitoes.

Didelis pilkas miško gyvūnas.
A big grey forest animal.
Wolves live in a big forest.

Gėlė, medis ar žolė – tai, kas žalia ir gyva.
A flower, a tree or grass — that which is green and alive.
In the room there are green plants.

Didelis aukštas augalas miške ar parke.
A big tall plant in the forest or the park.
By the house grows an old tree.
